a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan almost certainly leaves both of us empty when the first storm hits. The reserve holds only 4 cells, enough for one of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so you may prefer to operate or wait. If the episode continues past round 1, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. From here on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can refill toward 4 for you.
